runtime_stop.exempt: The game answers before it exits, because quitting first can end the process before the answer is written, so the answer holds no state after the stop. shutdown_requested and exit_code describe the request. The stop block checks the exit itself.

scene_call_method.exempt: Runs a project method whose effects only the project knows, and claims no state after it. returned is the method's own return value, taken from the call, so there is no post-state to read back and nothing an echo could copy.
